page_title: Custom Servers - Custom Tracks - Custom Cars - The Full Guide
heading_path: Custom Servers - Custom Tracks - Custom Cars - The Full Guide > Custom Server FAQ
text:
Custom Servers - Custom Tracks - Custom Cars - The Full Guide > Custom Server FAQ

> **Tier 3 was unlimited. Now it isn't. What happened?**
> Correct. Tier 3 had unlimited solo hosting and now has a 30 hour monthly allowance, with free hosting from ten drivers up. We changed it because unlimited solo hosting was filling the game with empty servers, and empty servers are where No Hesi is least fun.

> **Is this just to sell hour packs?**
> Packs exist and we sell them. Last month 98% of Tier 3 hosts used under 30 solo hours, so this limit will be invisible for most players. A server that stays full will never use a single hour.

> **I'm Tier 3 and I host way more than 30 hours. What do I do?**
> If others drivers are in your server, you'll be totally fine. Get ten or more and it costs nothing. If you genuinely drive **solo** for hours on end, packs cover it.

> **Does the host count toward the driver count?**
> Yes. You're one of the ten.

> **Someone joins mid session. Does my rate change right away?**
> Yes. The rate is live and recalculates as people join and leave. The panel reflects it as it happens.

> **Do I need a subscription to run a custom server?**
> No. Hour packs work on any account. $2.99 gets you 5 hours with full access inside your own server.

page_title: Custom Servers - Custom Tracks - Custom Cars - The Full Guide
heading_path: Custom Servers - Custom Tracks - Custom Cars - The Full Guide > Custom Server FAQ
text:
Custom Servers - Custom Tracks - Custom Cars - The Full Guide > Custom Server FAQ

> **Packs cost more per hour than a subscription. Why?**
> Because they're not a subscription. A pack is hours you own outright, on any account, with no monthly commitment, and they never expire. If you host regularly, a plan is cheaper. If you host occasionally, a pack means you're not paying for the other 25 days.

> **Do unused allowance hours roll over?**
> No. Your allowance resets on the 1st of each month.

> **Do purchased pack hours expire?**
> No, never. And your monthly allowance is always spent before your purchased hours, so nothing you paid for gets burned while free time is sitting there.

> **Does my server burn time when nobody is in it?**
> Yes, while it's running. But an empty server automatically shuts down after 15 minutes, so you can't lose your allowance to a server you forgot to close.

> **What happens when I hit zero?**
> You wait for the reset on the 1st, or you buy an hour pack. Packs start at $2.99.

> **Does public server play cost anything?**
> No. Public servers are free on every tier, including free accounts. Nothing here affects Public.

> **Is Traffic 2.0 available on Tier 1 and Tier 2 custom servers?**
> No. Traffic 2.0 in custom servers is Tier 3. Tier 1 and Tier 2 servers run AssettoServer traffic and get everything else in this update: custom maps, custom cars, advanced weather, damage, and the full plugin set.

> **Is Traffic 2.0 in custom servers finished?**
> No, it's in beta. Report what breaks here: [https://discord.com/channels/964645662866173972/1502872071040929902](https://discord.com/channels/964645662866173972/1502872071040929902)

heading_path: Custom Servers - Custom Tracks - Custom Cars - The Full Guide > Custom Server FAQ
text:
Custom Servers - Custom Tracks - Custom Cars - The Full Guide > Custom Server FAQ

> **Where do custom maps and cars come from?**
> Your own PC. If it's installed, you can use it, as long as it isn't server encrypted. Encrypted content simply won't work. We don't host, provide or download map or car files.

> **Do other players need the custom map or custom car installed to join?**
> Yes. Everyone in the server needs the same map and car files installed locally. That means... don't share paid or protected content to get people into your server. Do it and we'll remove you.

> **Do my presets carry over between servers?**
> No. Presets save per server. Tier 3 can save up to 100.

> **Why is 2 drivers only half rate? That feels rough on small crews.**
> The curve is tuned toward filling servers. We'll adjust based on what we see.

Checksum failed

**Checksum Failed will always only be caused by 1 of 2 things: a mismatch of files, or running out of RAM.**

> Follow every step below all at once to prevent weird issues from happening

heading_path: Checksum failed > Step 1:
text:
Checksum failed > Step 1:

> **Ensure your system meets requirements**

> * You must have **more than 16GB of RAM**
> * You must be using **DDR4 or newer RAM**

> Using **DDR3 RAM** or **only 16GB total** will cause checksum errors

**If you have 16GB of RAM or less, follow steps 2.1 to 2.5, otherwise, skip to Step 3**

Step 2.1
> On the start button right click and select system

Step 2.2
> On your right in related setting click on Advanced system settings

Step 2.3
> In the advanced tab performance case click on settings

heading_path: Checksum failed > Step 2.4
text:
Checksum failed > Step 2.4

> Advanced tab go in virtual memory and select change. Untick the case "Automatically manage paging file size". Select your faster drive with at least 16gb of free space. Select Custom size and write 16000 in initial size and maximum size and don't forget to click on Set

heading_path: Unfortunately, Assetto Corsa has crashed > Method 2
text:
Unfortunately, Assetto Corsa has crashed > Method 2

> **If you are crashing on the loading screen, take note of the very last piece of text, in the bottom left-hand corner of the loading screen, right before it crashes. This will be what is causing the crash.**

> **If it mentions a track:** Fully delete, and then manually reinstall the specified track: [how-to-install-delete-tracks-manually.md](../install-guides/how-to-install-delete-tracks-manually.md "mention")

> **If it mentions a car:** Fully delete, and then manually reinstall the specified car: [how-to-install-delete-cars-manually.md](../install-guides/how-to-install-delete-cars-manually.md "mention")

> **If it says: Connecting to IP:** You are having connection issues, and you should try to restart your PC, restart your router, limit devices on the network, limit background apps, etc.

heading_path: Unfortunately, Assetto Corsa has crashed > Method 3
text:
Unfortunately, Assetto Corsa has crashed > Method 3

> **If you are crashing right as you are entering the server, or crashing while playing the game, this is usually an indicator of your hardware maxing out due to your current settings.**

> **Step 1:** Ensure you exceed the PC requirements (see the PC Requirements FAQ)

> **Step 2:**

> 1. Reset all CSP settings to defaults (see "How to reset all CSP settings to defaults") (yes, this is reversible)
> 2. Restart your PC
> 3. Attempt to join a server again

> **Step 3:** Try limiting the load on your hardware further by doing:

> * [how-to-get-more-fps-csp-0.2.md](../performance-related/how-to-get-more-fps-csp-0.2.md "mention")
> * [how-to-get-more-fps-csp-0.3.md](../performance-related/how-to-get-more-fps-csp-0.3.md "mention")
> * [how-to-get-better-performance-in-srp.md](../performance-related/how-to-get-better-performance-in-srp.md "mention")

heading_path: Custom Shaders Patch > What is it?
text:
Custom Shaders Patch > What is it?

> Custom Shaders Patch (CSP) is an extension for Assetto Corsa that adds advanced visual effects, new physics features, and numerous optimizations. It enables features such as dynamic lighting, a full day-night cycle, improved weather systems, and enhanced graphics.

**Download**

> Custom Shaders Patch is distributed as a `.zip` archive from the [`official website.`](https://acstuff.club/patch/)

> Downloads follow this format:

> `lights-patch-v0.X.XX.zip` Where `X.XX` is the version number

> `lights-patch-v0.X.X-previewXXX-full.zip` Preview versions look like the following and enable rain

heading_path: Custom Shaders Patch > What CSP Version To Use:
text:
Custom Shaders Patch > What CSP Version To Use:

> **0.2.11 CSP: The most stable CSP version**
> **0.2.12 Preview: The recommended preview version**
>
> **We do not currently support CSP 0.3.0-preview+**

**Installation**

> There are two ways to install CSP:

**Content Manager**

> 1. Download the CSP `.zip` archive.
> 2. Open Content Manager.
> 3. Drag and drop the `.zip` file into the CM window.
> 4. CM will prompt to install CSP, confirm.
> 5. Wait for the install to complete.

**Manual Installation (Recommended)**

> 1. Download the CSP `.zip` archive.
> 2. Extract its contents to your root folder. Allow file overwrite if prompted.
> 3. Restart Content Manager to ensure changes are recognized.

**Always restart CM after installing CSP. Without a restart, CSP's configuration panel may not load properly or may display outdated settings.**

**Configuration**

> **After installing CSP:**

> 1. Open Content Manager.
> 2. Go to `Settings > Custom Shaders Patch > General Patch Settings.`
> 3. Enable CSP by ticking the checkbox at the top.
> 4. Review the modules listed in the left sidebar (e.g., WeatherFX, LightingFX, ExtraFX). You can enable or disable features as needed.

**If using Pure, ensure your CSP version meets Pure's minimum version requirement. Using older CSP builds can break weather features.**

It is **imperative that you follow their instructions** and not these. **Certain PP filters may require certain CSP/ Pure versions, and they may have their own install guide**, eg through bat files, etc. This guide is mercifully only a simple guide on how most, but not all, basic PP filters are installed.

text:

> 1. Find the relevant ZIP file in your downloads folder -> right-click -> `show more options` -> `7zip` -> `open archive`
> 2. You will usually find a few folders inside. You need to drag & drop these into your [root folder](../install-guides/root-folder-location.md). (**do NOT drag & drop into Content Manager**)

> **Note:** If the folder only contains a folder called: `assettocorsa`, please open it and drag the contents of that folder into your root folder.

heading_path: Manual PP-Filter installation > Step 3
text:
Manual PP-Filter installation > Step 3

> **Set up the PP filter:**

> 1. Open Content Manager -> Settings -> Assetto Corsa -> Video -> Post Processing
> 2. Select the PP filter from the drop down menu
> 3. Head to Content Manager -> Settings -> Custom Shaders Patch -> WeatherFX
> 4. Under `Weather Style` select the correct weather style for the PP filter you installed.

page_title: How to do a fresh start
heading_path: How to do a fresh start > Step 1
text:
How to do a fresh start > Step 1

> Delete the **Assetto Corsa Steam folder**, then uninstall the game from your Steam library if required.

Step 2
> Delete the **Assetto Corsa folder in "Documents"** (make a backup of this folder if you want to keep screenshots, graphics/controls presets, etc)

Step 3
> Delete the Content Manager folder

> * Press Windows key + R
> * Type in %localappdata% and hit enter
> * Delete the **"AcTools Content Manager"** folder.

page_title: How to do a fresh start
heading_path: How to do a fresh start > Step 4
text:
How to do a fresh start > Step 4

> If you have used the No Hesi launcher, please navigate to Settings > Apps > Installed Apps > No Hesi Launcher > the three dots > Uninstall, and follow all the prompts.

Step 5
> Follow an installation guide to set everything back up manually or via the launcher/automatic method.
>
> Launcher: [https://nohesi.gg/launcher](https://nohesi.gg/launcher)
> Content Manager / Manual Install: [manual-no-hesi-guide.md](manual-no-hesi-guide.md "mention")

heading_path: How To Enable 7 Zip Plugin
text:
How To Enable 7 Zip Plugin

**This is required for users who are facing issues installing missing content through Content Manager; typically, the error will include something about failing to extract the archive. This is not required if using the No Hesi launcher.**

Step 1
> Go to Settings

Step 2
> Click on Content manager

Step 3
> Click on Plugins

Step 4
> Check the 7 Zip plugin box.

heading_path: How to get Pure (PAID MOD)
text:
How to get Pure (PAID MOD)

**Paid Mod**

Step 1
> Go to [Pure's Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/peterboese/home) and subscribe to the **lowest level** to gain access.

Step 2
> 1. Click on the [Posts Tab](https://www.patreon.com/c/peterboese/posts)
> 2. Find the latest release of pure
> 3. Download it

heading_path: How to get Pure (PAID MOD) > Step 3
text:
How to get Pure (PAID MOD) > Step 3

**Download and Install 7zip. (do NOT use WinRAR)**

> 1. Open https://www.7-zip.org/
> 2. Click "Download"
> 3. Double-click the downloaded exe file
> 4. Follow the prompts to complete the install

heading_path: How to get Pure (PAID MOD) > Step 4
text:
How to get Pure (PAID MOD) > Step 4

**Install Pure manually:**

> 1. Locate the Pure ZIP file in your downloads folder
> 2. Right-Click -> (Show More Options) -> 7zip -> Open Archive
> 3. Inside of the 7zip window, click into the Pure folder
> 4. Drag & drop `apps`, `content`, `extension`, `system` into your AC root folder

> **Note:**
> You can also install Pure by dragging the zip into the No Hesi Launcher. (NEVER drag & drop into Content Manager)

heading_path: How to get Pure (PAID MOD) > Step 5
text:
How to get Pure (PAID MOD) > Step 5

> **Using Content Manager:**

> 1. Open Content Manager
> 2. Click Settings -> Custom Shaders Patch -> WeatherFX -> Weather Style
> 3. Select `Pure Gamma` or `Pure LCS`

> _The PP filter that you install later will be specifically made for 1 of these 2 versions; please ensure you double-check this, as otherwise the PP filter will not work as intended._

> 4. Click Drive -> Single -> Weather -> Pure

> **Using the No Hesi Launcher:**

> 4. Open the No Hesi Launcher
> 5. Click Settings -> Graphics -> WeatherFX style, and WeatherFX controller. 
> 6. Select `Pure Gamma` or `Pure LCS`

> _The PP filter that you install later will be specifically made for 1 of these 2 versions; please ensure you double-check this, as otherwise the PP filter will not work as intended._

**Warning:**

> Never install Pure by dragging & dropping it into Content Manager, it **MUST** be installed manually, as per the above!

> Never install both Pure and Sol at the same time! If you have had Sol installed in the past, please uninstall it using the `uninstall_sol.bat` file.

heading_path: How to get Pure (PAID MOD) > How To Get Rain
text:
How to get Pure (PAID MOD) > How To Get Rain

> Pure does **NOT** natively come with rain. In order to see rain when it's raining on servers, you must use a preview version of CSP. This is a paid version - see the "How to get rain (PAID mod)" FAQ.

heading_path: How to get Pure (PAID MOD) > How To Uninstall Pure > Step 1:
text:

How To Uninstall Pure > Step 2:
> Move this **uninstall\_pure.bat file into your root folder**.

How To Uninstall Pure > Step 3:
> Double-click the bat file, and follow the prompts to uninstall Pure.

> **Make sure to restart your PC afterwards.**

heading_path: How to get Setup Exchange
text:
How to get Setup Exchange

**Installation Process**

> Follow these steps to install Setup Exchange

Step 1
> Go in game, leave the pit menu, and move your mouse to the right side of the screen to find the **apps list**. Search for **App Shelf**

Step 2
> Open **App Shelf** and scroll down until you see **Setup Exchange**

Step 3
> Click on the **Setup Exchange** app and click **install**

Step 4
> Click **Keep Setup Integration Enabled**

Step 5
> Close **Setup Exchange**, and return to the pits menu

Step 6
> Click the **wrench icon** on **the left side of the screen**

Step 7
> **Setup Exchange** should now be displayed to **the right side of the tuning menu** by default

Step 8
> Click the **downward arrow icon** in **Setup Exchange**. Uncheck **Show setups for current track only**

How To Use
> Follow the following steps to get/upload tunes

heading_path: How to get Setup Exchange > How To Use > Step 1
text:
How to get Setup Exchange > How To Use > Step 1

> Clicking apply on any setup will **automatically apply the setup to your car**

How To Use > Step 2
> To create your own setup, simply click **Share current setup**, and provide a name for the setup

heading_path: How to install / delete cars manually > What this FAQ is for:
text:
How to install / delete cars manually > What this FAQ is for:

> If you are having issues with a specific car, please **ensure you delete any of its files before manually reinstalling it**. If you are simply here to manually install a car, then follow the second part of the guide.

page_title: How to install / delete cars manually
heading_path: How to install / delete cars manually > How to delete car files:
text:
How to install / delete cars manually > How to delete car files:

> All the cars you have installed will be found in your Assetto Corsa root folder -> `content` -> `cars`.

> Here you can find the car you need to delete -> right-click on it, then click `delete`.

> Please also delete the car folder/zip from anywhere else it may be, eg your downloads folder. This way you can start from a clean slate for the next step.

page_title: How to install / delete cars manually

page_title: How to make a LUT file
heading_path: How to make a LUT file > How to use: > Step 3
text:
How to make a LUT file > How to use: > Step 3

> Select "Step Log 2 (linear force test)" and wait until the test stops. The wheel will start to rotate back and forth, **DO NOT** touch it as it will make your LUT file heavily inaccurate.

How to use: > Step 4
> Extract LUTGenerator.zip that you have just downloaded and run LUTGenerator.exe

How to use: > Step 5
> Open the csv that was just generated by WheelCheck.

How to use: > Step 6
> Save the generated LUT in My Documents\Assetto Corsa\cfg\ folder, eg myLUT.lut

page_title: How to make a LUT file
heading_path: How to make a LUT file > How to use: > Step 7
text:
How to make a LUT file > How to use: > Step 7

> Open ff\_post\_process.ini located in My Documents\Assetto Corsa\cfg\ and make sure the TYPE=LUT, ENABLED=1 and CURVE = Generated LUT filename

**After this, do not alter the FFB Strength in your wheel's profiler! If you change the FFB Gain in your wheel's profiler, you should rerun wheelcheck+lut generator.**

> For example, if the file you produced with LUTGenerator is myLUT.lut, then this is how the ff\_post\_process.ini should look: \[HEADER] VERSION=1 TYPE=LUT ENABLED=1

> \[GAMMA] VALUE=1

> \[LUT] CURVE=myLUT.lut

> **It is recommended to do a LUT file once every month.**

text:

> Open Content Manager and go to Settings > Custom Shaders Patch > Car Instruments. Set these options to the same as the picture (you can tweak the Turn steering threshold). heading_path: How to fix Lost ForceFeedBack (FFB) when Alt-Tabbing
text:
How to fix Lost ForceFeedBack (FFB) when Alt-Tabbing

**Microsoft pushed out "Microsoft GameInput" Redistributable as part of one of the Xbox App updates, and that has been claiming exclusivity over FFB devices and causing issues.**

text:
How to get more FPS (CSP 0.2) > What this guide CAN and CANNOT do

> This guide will help you understand and optimise your settings for the best balance between quality and performance. Increase and decrease the settings as needed.

> This guide WILL not magically increase your FPS to 300 at 4k resolution and it will not make your PC itself better if the specs are terrible. **This guide is meant for Custom Shaders Patch versions 0.2.x**

heading_path: How to get more FPS (CSP 0.2) > What are some common causes of FPS issues?
text:
How to get more FPS (CSP 0.2) > What are some common causes of FPS issues?

* `Installing Pure by dragging it into CM.` - This causes heavy FPS drops.
* `Your CPU/GPU is not strong enough for your monitor resolution.` - If you have low-end hardware, avoid resolutions above 1080p. If you use a higher resolution monitor, lower the resolution in your GPU control panel.
* `Shadow and/or reflection resolution are set too high.` - Values between 3K-8K are usually overkill. For low- to mid-tier PCs, keep this at 1024-2048.
* `MSAA is set to 8x.` - Use 2x/turn it off on low-end systems, and 4x max if your PC can handle it.
* `Rain.` - Avoid using this if you're in need of more frames.
* `Tree skins.` - While they can drastically change the look of maps, its not recommended to use them if you are using low to mid-tier hardware.

**Assetto Corsa Video Settings**

**Resolution and FPS**

* `Rendering Mode:` Set to match your screen set up i.e One Monitor = Single Screen. Tick fullscreen as windowed mode usually diminishes frames.
* `Resolution:` Set this to match your monitor's resolution and refresh rate. Please note that the higher your resolution, the more demanding it is on your FPS.

> Do not enable `Fix Resolution Automatically`, `Vertical Synchronization`, or `Limit framerate`.

**Quality:**

heading_path: How to get more FPS (CSP 0.2) > What are some common causes of FPS issues?
text:
How to get more FPS (CSP 0.2) > What are some common causes of FPS issues?

* `MSAA:` Set to `2x` or `4x` depending on PC specs | Do not use `8x`.
* `Anisotropic Filtering:` Feel free to max this out.
* `World Details:` This is reliant on the track you are using but usually set this to `Medium` or `High`.
* `Shadow Resolution:` This is the biggest frame killer, set this to `512x512` or `1024x1024` | **NEVER** set this to anything above `2048x2048`.
* `Smoke Generation:` This setting is overridden by ParticlesFX but you can set this to `Medium` anyways.

**Reflections:**

* `Reflection Resolution:` Set this to either `512x512` or `1024x1024`.
* `Reflection Frequency:` **ONLY** set this to `Two face per frame`.
* `Rendering Distance:` Feel free to max this out.

**Post-Processing**

* `Enable Post-Processing Effects` - Have this checked/enabled.
* `Filter:` Depending on the filter you use, the impact can vary but usually the `defaults` and the `pure_` (if pure is installed) ones are the best for FPS.
* `Overall Quality:` Setting this to `High` or `Very High` should be sufficient.
* `Glare Quality:` Setting this to `High` or `Very High` should be sufficient.
* `Depth of Field:` Setting this to `Maximum` is fine as it only works during replays.
* `Motion Blur:` Set this to `Off`
* `Saturation:` Leave this at 100%
* `Heat Shimmering` - You can leave this off as it is not noticeable and can take some frames
* `Sunrays` - Leave this on
* `FXAA` - Leave this on

**Mirrors**

* `Mirror Resolution:` `128x512` or `256x1024` is sufficient and should provide a good balance.
* `High Quality` - Leave this on

**Custom Shaders Patch Settings**

heading_path: How to get more FPS (CSP 0.2) > What are some common causes of FPS issues?
text:
How to get more FPS (CSP 0.2) > What are some common causes of FPS issues?

* `CSP Settings > DXGI` - Make sure you have "Use new dxgi flip model" & "Triple buffering" checked, set Maximum latency to 1 frame.

* `General Patch Settings > GPU & CPU optimizations` - Make sure you have "Flatten nodes" & "Apply hyperthreading fix" checked, Set Chunks optimization to "advanced (experimental)". Under GPU optimization enable "Optimize meshes" & "Optimize meshes some more"

> **Important!** Since the Chinatown addition to 110 it is recommended to disable "Optimize meshes some more". To prevent any issues on the map keep this setting OFF! Set Chunk optimization to "Basic". If you don't have access to the 110 map / don't play it you can ignore this.

**If you followed the first 2 steps & still have low fps apply these changes as well:**

> LightningFX > Dynamic Shadows off

> GrassFX > off

> ParticleFX > Sparks off, Fireworks off, Solid Pieces off

> WindscreenFX > remove dirt completely on

> Brake DiscFX > off

> SkidmarksFX > set limit to 20k or lower

> Enable Triple Buffering, Lower MSAA, Lower Shadow Resolution, Lower Smoke Generation, Lower Reflection Resolution, Lower Mirror Resolution

**If it's still laggy after those changes:**

> ExtraFX > Uncheck active

> Graphics adjustments > AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) > on (Lower % presets look worse, but give bigger FPS boosts.)

> **Only use these last two options when you desperately need the FPS, out of the entire guide they affect your graphics the most.**

heading_path: Series 6.7 - Points - Ranks - Explained > What are Series?
text:
Series 6.7 - Points - Ranks - Explained > What are Series?

> No Hesi operates in Series, with each new series resetting the leaderboard, and often coming with a new point system or a new major update. Typically Series last a few months, and they are clearly announced before ending.

**The Point System**

> When cutting up through traffic, you will gain points based off how fast and close you can cut between other traffic cars.

> **Anti-Shoulder System:** When you are inside the shoulder for more than 3 seconds at a time, your multiplier will be nerfed completely. Once you hop back into the gameplay, outside the shoulder, you'll also have a 3 cooldown, before your multiplier will return to normal.

> **Lives:** Each run, you will have 2 lives. If you tap once, you will lose a small percentage of your current score, and if you tap twice, then your entire run will end.

> **Timer:** Each run has a maximum timer of 3 minutes. If you reach the 3 minute timer, without tapping twice, then your run will end.

> **First Person Multiplier:** If you are in first-person view, you will receive a bonus multiplier while cutting up. When you switch between first-person and other camera views, you'll be able to see a notification above the point UI, informing you about this.

> **Automatic Proximity System:** The crew system has been made obsolete, and now if you drive close enough to any player, you will automatically give them a bonus multiplier, without needing to be in an implicit crew group.

> **Passive Mode:** With the eradication of the implicit crew groups, it's highly recommened that you now enable passive mode to ensure no random players will be able to collide with you

**The Leaderboard**

heading_path: Series 6.7 - Points - Ranks - Explained > What are Series?
text:
Series 6.7 - Points - Ranks - Explained > What are Series?

> With Series 6.7 comes a per map leaderboard, which sorts everyone from highest to lowest points across the 3 maps. The maps are as follows:

> * Shuto Revival Project Beta
> * No Hesi 415
> * No Hesi 110

> On each leaderboard there is a ranking system of 7 ranks, 6 of which are make up of 3 tiers. These ranks are percentile based as you can see below:

> Certified -> 0.1%/Top 50 Capped, Sanctioned (I, II, III) -> 1% - 0.1%, Ghost (I, II, III) -> 5% - 1%, Licensed (I, II, III) -> 10% - 5%, Marked (I, II, III) -> 25% - 10%, Noticed (I, II, III) -> 50% - 25%, Listed (I, II, III) -> 100% - 50%

> **No Hesi Certified:** With the new per-map leaderboards, we have introduced a new top rank, called No Hesi Certified, which can be gained by holding the rank Certified across all the 3 maps. Having this new rank, will grant you free tier 3, and exclusive access to a new chat only for you guys.

> **Server Leaderboard:** This is just a small feature, which shows a leaderboard of the current highest scores that have been placed on that server with the players currently online.

heading_path: Missing UI / UI Not Working > Step 1:
text:
Missing UI / UI Not Working > Step 1:

> 1. Open Content Manager -> Settings -> Custom Shaders Patch -> About & Updates
> 2. Install **0.2.11 CSP**

Step 2:
> Go to CM -> Settings -> Custom Shaders Patch -> GUI -> New UI -> UI scale and **set it to 100%**

Step 3:
> Go to your root folder and delete everything inside the `cache` folder

heading_path: Missing UI / UI Not Working > Step 4
text:
Missing UI / UI Not Working > Step 4

**If the above did not fix it:**

> 1. Go to Content Manager -> Settings -> Assetto Corsa -> Controls -> Patch
> 2. Find `Hide UI completely`
> 3. Use this keybind in-game to make sure your UI wasn't completely hidden.
